about.title: A creative studio built for visual stories
about.body: WEPIC Photography is a creative photography studio established in 2024 in Doha, Qatar, specializing in high-quality visual content for individuals, entrepreneurs, startups, and growing businesses.
about.body2: From one portrait to a full month of social content, we plan, shoot, edit and color-grade everything in-house — and our studio is open for you to rent when you want to create on your own.
about.mission: To provide creative, professional, and impactful photography and videography that helps individuals and businesses showcase their identity, grow their brand, and connect with their audience.
about.vision: To become one of the leading creative photography and media production companies in Qatar and the region, recognized for innovation, quality, and exceptional client service.

services.title: Photography & video for every brand
services.intro: Every shoot is planned around what you need the images to do — sell, introduce, inspire or celebrate. We handle direction, lighting, editing and color grading.
services.pageIntro: Photography and videography for individuals, entrepreneurs, startups and growing businesses in Qatar. Shot in our studio or on location.
services.videoBody: Most of our shoots can include short-form video: reels, product films, speed-ramp car edits, behind-the-scenes and brand promos — shot, edited and color graded by our team.

corporate.title: Corporate & Business Photography
corporate.short: Headshots, team portraits and workplace imagery that make your company look as professional as it is.
corporate.long: Consistent, polished headshots and team portraits, plus images of your space and people at work — ready for your website, LinkedIn, company profile and press.

branding.title: Personal Branding
branding.short: Portraits that tell people who you are before you say a word.
branding.long: For founders, creators, coaches and professionals. We plan looks, locations and poses around your personality and audience so your online presence feels like you — only sharper.
points: Images for social, web and speaking

product.title: Product Photography
product.short: Clean, detailed and appetizing product images that sell.
product.long: From food and beverages to fashion, cosmetics and accessories — studio-lit product photography on clean or styled backgrounds, ready for e-commerce, menus and ads.

event.title: Event Photography
event.short: Coverage of launches, corporate events and celebrations — the moments and the details.
event.long: Discreet, professional coverage of openings, corporate gatherings, brand activations and private celebrations, with edited highlights ready for social media.

portrait.title: Portrait Photography
portrait.short: Studio portraits with character, light and mood.
portrait.long: Creative and classic portraits in our studio — from clean white backgrounds to dramatic colored light — for individuals, families, models and artists.

social.title: Social Media Content Creation
social.short: Scroll-stopping photos and reels made for Instagram and TikTok.
social.long: Content designed for the platforms you post on: vertical reels, carousels and stories, planned in batches so your feed stays consistent. Also available as a monthly package.

commercial.title: Commercial Photography
commercial.short: Campaign imagery for brands, cars, fashion and hospitality.
commercial.long: Advertising-grade photography and film for campaigns — including automotive shoots at Doha's landmarks, fashion lookbooks and hospitality visuals.

startup.title: Startup Business Photography
startup.short: A complete visual starter kit for new businesses.
startup.long: Launching a business? We create the core set of images you need to go live: founder portraits, product or service shots, and content for your website and first campaigns.

lifestyle.title: Lifestyle Photography
lifestyle.short: Natural, story-driven images of people living with your brand.
lifestyle.long: Authentic images of people in real moments — fitness, fashion, food and city life — that help your audience imagine your brand in their day.

marketing.title: Marketing & Promotional Photography
marketing.short: Images and videos built for ads, offers and launches.
marketing.long: Promotional visuals designed around your campaign: bold product hero shots, seasonal content such as Ramadan campaigns, and promo videos for paid social.

packages.title: Our Monthly Packages
packages.intro: Three monthly content packages designed to help build a consistent and premium social media presence.
packages.note: Need something different? Every service is also available as a one-off shoot — ask us for a quote.

kb.packages:
We offer three monthly content packages:
• Basic — QAR 2,500/month: 1 location, 1 session, 20 edited photos, 3 reels.
• Essential — QAR 3,900/month: up to 2 locations, 1–2 sessions, 25 edited photos, 6 reels.
• Premium — QAR 5,900/month: up to 2 locations, 1–2 sessions, 30 edited photos, 10 reels, content planning support and priority delivery.
All include professional editing & color grading and social-media-ready delivery. Would you like to book one?
kb.studio: Our studio on C-Ring Road is one of the biggest in Doha. It has a white infinity cove, styled sets (majlis, purple lounge, pink paneled wall, black curtain, 3D-panel wall), professional lighting, a makeup station and a podcast setup. You can rent it hourly, for a half day (4 hours) or a full day (8 hours). Rates are confirmed on booking — would you like to request a date?
kb.hours: We're open Sunday to Thursday. Exact opening times are confirmed when you book — message us on WhatsApp at +974 3388 3327.
kb.location: We're at C-Ring Road, Building 244, 1st floor, Doha, Qatar. Here's the map: {map}
kb.services: We shoot corporate & business, personal branding, product, event, portrait, social media content, commercial, startup, lifestyle and marketing & promotional photography — plus videography and reels. Which one are you interested in?
kb.podcast: Yes — you can record your podcast at WEPIC with premium audio (RØDE PodMic microphones) and multi-camera recording in a styled set. Want to book a session?
kb.prices: Monthly packages are QAR 2,500 (Basic), QAR 3,900 (Essential) and QAR 5,900 (Premium). Studio rental and one-off shoots are quoted on request — I can send your request to the team on WhatsApp.
kb.about: WEPIC Photography is a creative photography studio established in 2024 in Doha, Qatar, creating high-quality visual content for individuals, entrepreneurs, startups and growing businesses.

kb.unknown: I'm not sure about that one. I can help with packages, services, studio rental, opening days, location or making a booking — or you can ask the team directly on WhatsApp at +974 3388 3327.
